items.title: Marine Weather Statement issued April 9 at 9:17PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.summary:
Isolated to scattered showers and possible thunderstorms are
expected to move into the southern California coastal waters,
north of Point Conception Friday morning into Friday afternoon.
Thunderstorms will bring the threat of cloud to ocean lightning,
locally gusty winds, heavy rain, small hail, and waterspouts.
These conditions can create hazardous ocean conditions, especially
for smaller vessels. Mariners are advised to have a plan to reach
safe harbor quickly if thunderstorms develop.
